children: Defence engineering firm Nibe Ltd on Friday (September 18) said it has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with France's Naval Group on naval shipbuilding and defence technologies, including underwater drones, submarine systems, mine countermeasure systems and naval weapon launching systems.
The agreement establishes a framework for cooperation between Naval Group and Nibe Group across shipbuilding, defence platforms and autonomous systems.

The partnership will cover underwater drones and their integration onboard submarines, future weapon-ready modular launching systems, mine countermeasure systems and engineering, according to the company.
Nibe and Naval Group said the partnership is aimed at strengthening India’s self-reliance in naval programmes under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.

Naval Group has been present in India for more than a decade and has supported the Indian naval defence industry through a network of industrial partnerships. The company said the partnership with Nibe will combine the experience and expertise of both companies to support the Indian Navy.

Marie-Laure Bourgeois, EVP, Sales & Marketing, Naval Group, said, "This agreement illustrates our shared commitment to develop sovereign, resilient, and future-ready naval capabilities in India and exemplifies our commitment to the Special Global Strategic Partnership shared between India and France."

"Nibe's strong expertise in delivering integrated defence solutions that power India's strategic autonomy, backed by continued investment in the sector, will be an asset to the cooperation with Naval Group in order to provide the latest generation of naval technologies for the country," Ganesh Nibe, Chairman and Managing Director of Nibe Group.
Shares of Nibe Ltd ended at ₹1,285.80, up by ₹39.20, or 3.14%, on the BSE.

title: Nibe, France's Naval Group signs MoU for naval shipbuilding, defence technologies
